zh.name: 实拍与技术草图对照
zh.summary: 把同一件物品的实拍与结构草图并置，让外观和设计细节互相解释。
zh.useWhen: 两种表现必须对应同一对象，尺寸和结构不能由照片猜造。
zh.instructions: 实物照片、实际设计草图、允许展示的结构信息
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Photo and Technical Sketch
en.summary: Create an Instagram showcase carousel using the photo and technical sketch structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the photo and technical sketch format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

imageCues: 浅灰/白色棚拍底，人物/产品实拍占中间60–70%，同一对象的细线技术图在右下或局部叠合，名字以手写48–62px置左上
3–4条手写注释30–38px及细弧箭头指向真实结构
